outcome: Give the operator somewhere to read what actually went wrong, so an error that must not be shown to a caller is not simply discarded.
non_goals: Do not put a dependency's message into a response in order to make it visible
Do not record a credential value, a prompt or a raw provider response
Do not make a record the caller can cause to grow without bound

transitions.reason: the error-classification design measured that no file outside a test imports a logger anywhere in the service or its commands, so the moment an unclassified error stops being returned to the caller its text goes nowhere at all. Until now the only reason anyone could see a storage fault was that it was being mis-sent to the caller as their own mistake, which is the very thing being fixed
the task that stops sending the text to the caller decides what the text is, so it goes first
every task this one depends on is complete, so the block has cleared

the operator record has exactly one conflict-free window: after the quota true-up settles the budget row the error classification pins, and before the scheduler identity takes both of its source files and everything after inherits them
